title: Bank of England MPC decision, 12:00 London / 08:00 ET — the non-Report meeting immediately before the April MPR, and the boundary that defines what the 2027-04-29 committee is seeing for the first time
source: EST: bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy/upcoming-mpc-dates, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the page's '2027 provisional dates' block reads verbatim 'Thursday 4 February — February MPC Summary and minutes and February Monetary Policy Report', 'Thursday 18 March — March MPC Summary and minutes', 'Thursday 29 April — April MPC Summary and minutes and April Monetary Policy Report', 'Thursday 17 June', 'Thursday 29 July', 'Thursday 16 September', 'Thursday 4 November', 'Thursday 16 December'. The Bank's own heading is 'provisional dates', which is the honest reason for estimate on top of this lane's no-self-confirm limit and the taxonomy gap: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix list has no slot for a foreign central bank. Discovered 2026-09-09 during the never-assessed initial research of uk-cpi-2027-04-21
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-cpi-2027-04-21 LANE, 2026-09-09. This is a NON-REPORT meeting — the Bank's own listing gives it 'MPC Summary and minutes' with no Monetary Policy Report, unlike 2027-02-04, 2027-04-29 and 2027-07-29 — and it is proposed for exactly one structural reason rather than for a rate call: it is the BOUNDARY that makes the April committee's information set countable. Without this date on the calendar, 'the 2027-04-29 committee sees two CPI prints since its last meeting' (uk-cpi-2027-03-24 on 24 March and uk-cpi-2027-04-21 on 21 April, both verified primary the same day) cannot be checked from the calendar alone. It also fixes the sequencing that two other lanes are reasoning about: this meeting sits BEFORE the 24 March February CPI print by six days, so the last CPI reading this committee has is the January print of 2027-02-17 — the one that also publishes the 2027 CPI weights on which uk-cpi-2027-05-19's and uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01's step-size bands depend. THE BANK'S 2027 CALENDAR IS THINLY DIARISED HERE GENERALLY: of the eight 2027 provisional dates, only 2027-04-29 was on this calendar, with 2027-06-17 proposed by a sibling lane. This proposal covers the one whose absence was load-bearing for a claim already in flight; the remaining five are noted, not proposed, because nothing on the calendar depends on them yet. Tiered LOW rather than medium to match every other UK entry here: symbols: [], no UK listing, gilt or sterling instrument on this calendar, no rates- or FX-keyed house playbook, and the only UK-to-US transmission this repo has ever measured is the gilt-to-Treasury pipe in uk-autumn-budget-2026-10-28, which opens on the worst ~1% of gilt days. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
